page.overview:
What is Aithe High Street?

Aithe High Street was a the main road that passed through Aithelar in Callidyrr on the Moonshae Isles in this story — part of Dungeons & Dragons.

Aithe High Street passed through the center of town, running north to south. It intersected many of Aithelar's other streets including Bottle Lane, Whitefish Alley, Eel Street, Rope End Lane, Finn's Alley, Aerynn's Street, Blackdorn's Way and Blaedar Street. At its southern end, the street approached Aithe Keep as it left town.
